hints.title: Two-Phase Propagation
hints.text: Water spreads to adjacent empty cells each second, while the player also moves to adjacent safe cells.

hints.title: Water Arrival Times
hints.text: Compute the exact second when water first reaches each cell using a multi-source breadth-first search from all initial water cells.

hints.title: Player BFS Constraint
hints.text: Run a second breadth-first search for the player. The player can only step onto cell (r, c) at time t if t is strictly less than the water arrival time at (r, c).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two breadth-first search passes: multi-source water flood and player pathfinding.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating synchronized step-by-step state space is slower than precomputing the static flood timeline.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(R * C) matrix for water arrival times.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precompute arrival fields to decouple the flood simulation from player traversal.
